paper_judgement: Promising Water Research process-paper core, but not a fully locked claim because only one small/large tide campaign pair is available. The defensible main story is a spring–neap tidal-energy-controlled stratified ↔ mixed-resuspension state transition with FDOM vertical reorganization; universal thresholds and simple deoxygenation are not supported.
